facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-4103 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4103 and M-4103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 30 March 2013 an incident occurred on P-4103 and M-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
